description: Phase 7 — original visual identity + accessibility across the existing screens. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 because it restyles the Focus and Certificate screens those features add/modify; sequenced LAST so it polishes the final screen set instead of being reworked. Polish only — do NOT rebuild screens or change honest states/behavior. Centralize a small theme + reusable components, apply them everywhere, make loading/offline/empty/error/permission states consistent, and verify accessibility on the main journey with a lightweight test (labels/roles present, touch targets >= 44pt, reduce motion respected).
steps: Create src/ui/theme/index.ts: an original calm neutral palette with exactly ONE confident accent color, a type scale (sizes/weights), a spacing scale, radii, and MIN_TOUCH_TARGET=44; plus useReduceMotion(): boolean wrapping react-native AccessibilityInfo.isReduceMotionEnabled() + its change subscription (defaults to motion-reduced-safe if the query fails). No imitation of any other app's identity.

Create reusable components consuming the theme: src/ui/components/AppButton.tsx (accessibilityRole='button', min height 48, required accessibilityLabel passthrough, honest disabled state via accessibilityState), src/ui/components/Card.tsx, and src/ui/components/Screen.tsx (safe-area-padded container that standardizes loading/offline/empty/error/permission states by reusing src/ui/components/ScreenState). Keep ScreenState as the shared primitive.

Restyle the main-journey screens onto the theme + components without changing behavior or honest states: src/ui/screens/HomeScreen.tsx, TrackSelectScreen.tsx, CoursePathScreen.tsx, LessonScreen.tsx, PracticeScreen.tsx, ResultScreen.tsx, MasteryScreen.tsx, MasteryResultScreen.tsx, ProgressScreen.tsx, FocusScreen.tsx, CertificateScreen.tsx, CertificateDetailScreen.tsx, SettingsScreen.tsx. Apply: calm backgrounds, one accent, readable spacing/typography, large touch targets, warm student-friendly copy, honest progress indicators (NO fabricated percentages), and a restrained celebration on REAL level completion only that is short-circuited when useReduceMotion() is true. This is one same-pattern edit batched across the listed files.

Ensure accessibility on the main journey: every interactive element exposes a non-empty accessibilityLabel and an accessibilityRole; sensible focus/reading order (logical element order); dynamic-type-friendly sizing; sufficient contrast from the theme; layouts that hold on smaller iPhone widths (no fixed widths that overflow).

Add __tests__/accessibility.test.tsx using the screens.smoke harness: render Home, Focus, Certificate detail, and Settings and assert every interactive element (Pressable/button) exposes a non-empty accessibilityLabel and an accessibilityRole, and that AppButton styles resolve to a min height >= MIN_TOUCH_TARGET; assert reduce-motion short-circuits the celebration animation (mock AccessibilityInfo.isReduceMotionEnabled -> true). Adjust existing smoke-test copy assertions ONLY where copy intentionally changed, never to mask a regression.
Run the full verification matrix and fix any regression introduced by restyling before marking done.
acceptance_criteria: A single theme module + reusable AppButton/Card/Screen components exist and the listed screens consume them; no screen invents an ad-hoc palette.
No behavior or honest state changed: Focus still shows honest unavailable, certificates still only for complete levels, no fabricated percentages.

__tests__/accessibility.test.tsx asserts accessibilityLabel + accessibilityRole presence on interactive elements and touch targets >= 44pt on key journey screens, and that reduce motion disables the celebration.
npx tsc --noEmit passes, npm run lint is clean, the full npx jest suite is green, and node scripts/validate-catalog.mjs is still valid.
verification: npx jest  (full suite green, including screens.smoke after restyle)
npm run lint  (clean; no unused imports)
findings: COMPLETED. POLISH-ONLY — no behaviour or honest state changed (Focus still honest-unavailable on the jest host, certificates still only for complete levels, no fabricated percentages, all copy preserved). New theme: src/ui/theme/index.ts exports MIN_TOUCH_TARGET=44, an ORIGINAL calm warm-neutral palette with exactly ONE accent (grounded teal #0E7C6B + accentPressed/accentSoft/onAccent) plus semantic success/danger/warning (used sparingly, not a second brand), spacing (4pt grid xs..xxl), radii (sm/md/lg/pill), a typography scale (display/title/heading/body/bodyStrong/label/caption with line heights friendly to dynamic type), a `theme` aggregate, and useReduceMotion(): boolean that wraps AccessibilityInfo.isReduceMotionEnabled() + its 'reduceMotionChanged' subscription and DEFAULTS motion-reduced-safe (true) if the query throws. New reusable components: src/ui/components/AppButton.tsx (accessibilityRole='button', REQUIRED accessibilityLabel passthrough defaulting to label, honest disabled via accessibilityState + 0.5 opacity, minHeight=MIN_TOUCH_TARGET, variants primary/secondary/danger mapping to the one accent + danger), Card.tsx (surface/muted/accent tones), Screen.tsx (safe-area-padded themed canvas via useSafeAreaInsets; a discriminated `status` prop centralizes loading/empty/error/permission by delegating to ScreenState, else renders ready children in a ScrollView or View). ScreenState.tsx restyled onto the theme and its retry button now uses AppButton. New Celebration.tsx: a restrained single accent banner shown ONLY on a real badge/level-completion edge; entrance fade+rise via Animated is SHORT-CIRCUITED when useReduceMotion() (or reduceMotionOverride) is true (resting opacity 1 / translateY 0), message still shown; accessibilityLiveRegion='polite'. Restyled onto theme+components (same-pattern batch, behaviour unchanged): Home, TrackSelect, CoursePath, Lesson, Practice, Result, Mastery, MasteryResult, Progress, Focus, Certificate, CertificateDetail, Settings. Result + MasteryResult now render the level-complete line through Celebration (MasteryResult keeps the separate 'You earned the <level> badge.' line as plain text so the smoke 'You completed the' assertion and badge copy both hold). Focus keeps the exact honest-unavailable copy (REASON_TEXT, 'unavailable', no 'blocked'/'blocking'/'session active'); duration chips kept as Pressables but each gained an accessibilityLabel ('Set duration <label>') so every interactive element is labeled. New test __tests__/accessibility.test.tsx (6 tests): renders Home/Focus/CertificateDetail/Settings through the screens.smoke-style provider+navigation harness and asserts every interactive node (onPress OR role button/radio/checkbox) has a non-empty accessibilityLabel + accessibilityRole; asserts AppButton's flattened style minHeight >= MIN_TOUCH_TARGET; asserts reduce motion (AccessibilityInfo.isReduceMotionEnabled -> true) short-circuits the Celebration to the resting opacity/transform while still rendering the message. No smoke-test copy assertions needed changing (copy was preserved intentionally). VERIFICATION all green: npx tsc --noEmit exit 0; npx jest accessibility 6/6; full npx jest 167/167 (14 suites, was 161 before +6 a11y); npm run lint 0 errors (4 pre-existing require() warnings in test files for the AsyncStorage mock, matching the established harness pattern); node scripts/validate-catalog.mjs valid. The whole-suite console.warn 'dropped malformed completed level' is the pre-existing benign FakeClock-epoch-0 case from FEAT-002, not introduced here. No Swift modified; no expo prebuild/xcodebuild run.
